en:
He complains about others, but he can't even
take care of himself... Irresponsible idiot...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Maki for a while?

...I was about to go on a walk. You can tag
along if you want...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time strolling around
the courtyard with Maki.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
